review_notes: I read all 75 lines of the target file and inspected the supporting definitions and lemmas it uses: SpectralOverlapPaths.lean (spectralPathDensity, spectralGroupPath, spectralGroupDiagonal, nonnegativity, continuityOn, interval integrability, diagonal bounds), SpectralPaths.lean (projectedResolventDerivative), Core/Variational.lean (OverlapPath, deficit), and CavityCanonicalBlockLimit.lean; I also grepped all uses of cavityCanonicalCoordinate/cavityCanonicalLabel and projIcc_of_mem across the InvariantIsing tree. The main two improvements are (1) the equality lemma at_path is stated only for arguments in the range of p, although the un-clamping fact holds for every t in Icc 0 1, and downstream files repeatedly unfold and rewrite this by hand; (2) the whole file hard-codes Fin m even though the underlying spectral API is generic over any finite index type and none of the proofs inspect the Nat/Fin structure. I considered but rejected two further changes: restricting the label codomain to Icc 0 1 would break the intentional `SpectralEntry m := Fin m → Icc (-1) 1` API used downstream, and replacing spectralPathDensity by an arbitrary nonnegative integrand would mostly restate standard one-line interval-integral facts while obscuring the spectral API, so it is not a clear practical improvement here. Proposed replacements are not compiled in this review, so exact instance inference remains untested.

findings.excerpt:
lemma cavityCanonicalCoordinate_at_path {m : ℕ} (ρ eig : Fin m → ℝ) (hρ : ∀ a, 0 < ρ a)
    (hρsum : ∑ a, ρ a = 1) (p : OverlapPath) (a : Fin m) (s : ℝ) :
    cavityCanonicalCoordinate ρ eig hρ hρsum p a (p s) = spectralGroupPath ρ eig hρ hρsum p a s := by
  unfold cavityCanonicalCoordinate spectralGroupPath
  rw [Set.projIcc_of_mem zero_le_one ⟨p.nonneg s, p.le_one s⟩]
findings.problem: The only evaluation lemma for cavityCanonicalCoordinate is restricted to arguments of the form p s, i.e. to the range of the particular OverlapPath p. The actual computation (the projection Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one t is the identity) is valid for every t ∈ Icc 0 1, and the equality with spectralGroupPath is only the special case that additionally unfolds spectralGroupPath. Because no such general lemma is exported, downstream files must unfold cavityCanonicalCoordinate and rewrite Set.projIcc_of_mem by hand (CavitySpinObservable.lean:18, CavityFiniteHeightContinuity.lean:20-21, CavityFiniteReplicaCovariance.lean:86, CavityCanonicalContinuity.lean:60, CavityRecalculatedLabels.lean:47). In particular, values at endpoints such as t = 1, where the coordinate is the diagonal, are not available from this file unless p happens to attain 1.
findings.proposed_change:
Add the general evaluation lemma

lemma cavityCanonicalCoordinate_of_mem {m : ℕ} (ρ eig : Fin m → ℝ) (hρ : ∀ a, 0 < ρ a)
    (hρsum : ∑ a, ρ a = 1) (p : OverlapPath) (a : Fin m) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    cavityCanonicalCoordinate ρ eig hρ hρsum p a t =
      ∫ r in 0..t, spectralPathDensity ρ eig hρ hρsum p a r := by
  unfold cavityCanonicalCoordinate
  rw [Set.projIcc_of_mem zero_le_one ht]

and derive the existing lemma from it (as `simpa only [spectralGroupPath]` using it at ⟨p.nonneg s, p.le_one s⟩). Endpoint corollaries also follow by the same membership rewrites: t = 0 gives 0 (`integral_same`) and t = 1 gives `spectralGroupDiagonal ρ eig hρ hρsum p a`, without any assumption that p attains the endpoint. Degenerate cases t < 0 and t > 1 remain handled by the clamp and are not affected, since the new lemma only claims membership in Icc 0 1.
findings.benefit: Users get the coordinate in the form of the spectral primitive at every overlap level in [0,1], not only at values produced by one chosen path, and the repeated unfold-and-rewrite pattern in five downstream files can be replaced by one named lemma. It also makes the relation to spectralGroupPath a corollary rather than the primary form.

findings.problem: Every declaration in the file fixes the index set to Fin m, although no statement or proof uses any order, casting or arithmetic structure of Fin m: the only inputs are the pointwise positivity and unit sum of ρ, and the only spectral facts invoked (spectralPathDensity_nonneg, spectralPathDensity_intervalIntegrable, spectralGroupDiagonal_le_one) are all stated for an arbitrary finite index type. The immediately underlying layer is generic (`variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]` in SpectralOverlapPaths.lean), so these results are unnecessarily restricted to one concrete finite type and cannot be reused for another finite indexing without transporting along an equivalence to Fin m.
findings.proposed_change: Replace the binder `{m : ℕ} (ρ eig : Fin m → ℝ) ... (a : Fin m)` in all seven declarations (cavityCanonicalCoordinate, the four cavityCanonicalCoordinate_* lemmas, cavityCanonicalLabel and continuous_cavityCanonicalLabel) by `{ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (ρ eig : ι → ℝ) (hρ : ∀ a, 0 < ρ a) (hρsum : ∑ a, ρ a = 1) ... (a : ι)`. The proof terms can be kept verbatim, since they only instantiate the generic spectral lemmas above and the membership facts of Set.projIcc; no case analysis on the index occurs. For an empty index type the hypothesis hρsum is unsatisfiable, so there is no additional degenerate case, and a : ι is never constructed. (This has not been elaborated in this review.)
findings.benefit: The cavity canonical-coordinate API then matches the generality of the spectral-density API it is built on: any finite index type (for example a sum or product of block index types) can use these results directly instead of re-deriving them or reindexing to Fin m. Because the assumptions are unchanged, existing Fin m call sites keep working through inference.
